The '''black bear''' was a type of [[Bear/Legends|bear]] known in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A large [[Unidentified bear-like creature|creature]] from<ref name="M13">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="Mycroftsystem">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Mycroft system/Legends|Mycroft system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]] resembled a [[Color/Legends|black]] bear, although it also had mottled green [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and [[Limb/Legends|hands]] similar to those of a [[raccoon]].<ref name="M13" />

==Behind the scenes==
The black bear was first mentioned in "[[Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|Assault on Repair Station M13]]," a [[roleplaying game]] scenario that was written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published in the [[1988]] ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="M13" /> In the real world, the [[Wikipedia:American black bear|black bear]] is a common species of bear found in [[Wikipedia:North America|North America]].<ref name="Dict">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/black%20bear|text=Black bear Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20220926023744}}</ref>
